homeowners.generalInfoTitle: How does the urban transformation process work end to end?
homeowners.generalInfoBody: The 3-step flow on DönüşümKapısı only covers the contractor-matching part. Below is a general outline of the full process a building goes through during transformation.
homeowners.process1Body: The building's earthquake safety is technically inspected by authorized institutions.
homeowners.process2Body: A majority of the land share (more than half) approves the decision to proceed with the transformation.
homeowners.process3Body: Offers are compared and a contract is signed with the chosen contractor — this is the stage where DönüşümKapısı gets involved.
homeowners.process4Body: Demolition and construction permits are obtained from the municipality and relevant authorities.
homeowners.process5Body: The building is vacated and the existing structure is demolished.
homeowners.process6Body: The foundation and load-bearing system are completed.
homeowners.process7Body: Interior, utilities, façade and landscaping work is carried out.
homeowners.process8Body: The occupancy permit is obtained and units are handed over to their owners.

faq.introBefore: The most common questions about the urban transformation process and DönüşümKapısı. If you can't find what you're looking for,
faq.cat1q1: What exactly does urban transformation mean?
faq.cat1a1: It is the process, under Law No. 6306, of demolishing buildings that cannot provide adequate earthquake safety or have reached the end of their structural life, and rebuilding them to safe, up-to-date construction standards.
faq.cat1q2: Why is a building declared a "risky structure"?
faq.cat1a2: If a technical inspection (soil survey and structural assessment) carried out by authorized institutions finds that a building's earthquake safety is inadequate, this is reported to the relevant authority and the risky-structure status is formalized. This determination is the first official step of the transformation process.
faq.cat1q3: Is approval from all unit owners required for the transformation decision?
faq.cat1a3: No. Under the regulations, a decision made by the majority of the land share (more than half) is binding on all owners. The shares of owners who do not agree with the decision may be evaluated by the relevant authority.
faq.cat2q1: What are the general stages of the urban transformation process?
faq.cat2Step2: Owners reach agreement via majority land share
faq.cat2q2: How long does the whole process take?
faq.cat2a2: The timeline depends on the building's size, the number of owners, municipal processes, and the contractor's capacity. In general it can take several years from risk assessment to handover; rather than a fixed figure, we recommend asking the contractors you receive offers from for a project-based timeline.
faq.cat2q3: What happens to the rights of tenants or occupants during the process?
faq.cat2a3: Matters such as evacuation and rent assistance may vary according to relevant regulations and current government support programs. For up-to-date, binding information, we recommend consulting the official resources of Turkey's Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change — DönüşümKapısı is not an official institution in this matter and only provides contractor matching.
faq.cat3q1: Is there government support for urban transformation?
faq.cat3a1: Government-supported campaigns that occasionally include rent assistance, loan support, or grants are announced from time to time. Since the scope, amounts, and applicability of these programs vary by city/district, we recommend confirming up-to-date, verified information through official institution channels.
faq.cat3q2: Does DönüşümKapısı calculate or apply for these supports on my behalf?
faq.cat3a2: No. DönüşümKapısı is not a government institution and does not offer official application or calculation services. Our platform's role is to match your listing with verified contractors; for exact figures on support programs, we recommend speaking with the relevant official institution.
faq.cat4q1: Is posting a listing as a homeowner paid?
faq.cat4a1: No, posting a listing is free. Your listing is reviewed by our team before going live.
faq.cat4q2: Can I contact a contractor directly?
faq.cat4a2: There is no direct communication channel between users on the platform. When you're interested in a contractor's offer, your request goes to the DönüşümKapısı team; we organize the actual contact (phone, appointment). This is to keep the process secure and transparent.
faq.cat4q3: How can I submit offers as a contractor?
faq.cat4a3: After registering for free and uploading your documents (tax certificate, trade registry, etc.) and having them verified by our team, you can submit price and timeline offers on live listings.
faq.cat5q1: I had a support issue with another platform or contractor before — will I face the same here?
faq.cat5a1: We understand this concern — the most common complaint in urban transformation is not being able to reach anyone after posting a listing. On DönüşümKapısı, all communication is handled through our team; your request is never left unattended — it's assigned to a responsible team member and followed up until the process is complete.
faq.cat5q2: I'm not satisfied with a contractor or can't reach them — what should I do?
faq.cat5a2LinkText: Reach us through our contact page
faq.cat5a2After: or via the support request in your panel. We record your complaint against the relevant contractor's file, request an explanation from the contractor if needed, and review the account in cases of repeated complaints.
faq.cat5q3: How long does it take for my complaint to be reviewed?
faq.cat5a3: Support requests are usually answered by our team within 1-2 business days. In serious cases, such as suspected forged documents, we prioritize the request.
faq.cat5q4: Is DönüşümKapısı responsible if a contractor fails to meet the contract terms?
faq.cat5a4: DönüşümKapısı is not a construction or contracting company; it is a matching platform that connects homeowners with contractors. Obligations under the contract and construction process are between the parties. However, we verify the documents of contractors on our platform and review — and remove if necessary — accounts that receive serious complaints.
faq.cat5q5: Is my identity shared with the contractor when I submit a complaint?
faq.cat5a5: No. We ask that you provide the listing number or contractor information so we can review your complaint, but your identity is only shared with the relevant team members, never directly with the contractor.

corporate.aboutLead: Kentsel dönüşümde ev sahibi ile müteahhiti güvenli şekilde buluşturan arabuluculuk platformu.

corporate.aboutBody2: Taraflar birbirine doğrudan ulaşmaz. Telefon, randevu ve görüşme DönüşümKapısı ekibi tarafından organize edilir. Bu model hem güvenliği artırır hem de eşleştirme üzerinden komisyon modelimizi şeffaf tutar.
corporate.aboutBody3: Amacımız; ev sahiplerinin doğru müteahhitle buluşması, müteahhitlerin filtrelenmiş fırsatlara odaklanması ve sürecin tek irtibat noktasından yönetilmesidir.
corporate.contactLead: Platform hattı — taraflar arası değil, sizinle bizim aramızdaki kanal.
corporate.contactBody: İlan, teklif, randevu veya hesap konularında yalnızca bu kanallardan yazın. Ev sahibi veya müteahhit iletişim bilgilerini paylaşmayız; eşleşmeyi biz yönetiriz.
corporate.contactWhatsApp: Merhaba, DönüşümKapısı hakkında bilgi almak istiyorum.
corporate.privacyBody1: Hesap, ilan ve teklif süreçlerinde ad, e-posta, telefon ve bina bilgileri toplanabilir. Bu veriler yalnızca eşleştirme, doğrulama ve yasal yükümlülükler için kullanılır.
corporate.privacyBody2: İletişim bilgileri karşı tarafa yalnızca karşılıklı ilgi oluştuğunda ve DönüşümKapısı aracılığıyla paylaşılır.
corporate.privacyBody3: Haklarınız ve talepleriniz için info@donusumkapisi.com adresine yazabilirsiniz.
corporate.termsLead: Platformu kullanarak bu şartları kabul etmiş sayılırsınız.
